input_types: Caller-supplied offline source-snapshot JSONL manifest with relative capture files, per-capture SHA-256 lock, expected canonical source-set SHA-256, question, draft, claim-review JSONL, task/episode/source-set identifiers, and an output path outside the repository.
required_outputs: A new run directory containing a manifest, receipt, report, normalized sources, claim-anchor ledger, copied review inputs, raw captures, and artifact hashes.
